svg.title: Methylene blue's key randomized trials: no clear win in the big ones
svg.desc: Methylene blue's key randomized trials: no clear win in the big ones. Lancet 2016, mild-moderate Alzheimer's, 891 people: Main goals not met. 2018 mild Alzheimer's trial, 800 people: Plan revised; non-randomized comparison. LUCIDITY 2026, Alzheimer's/MCI, 598 people: Main goals not met at 52 weeks. Phase 2 2015, Alzheimer's, 321 people: Mixed, dose-finding. Surgery 2021, IV, open-label, 248 people: Less delirium after surgery. PTSD 2017, with exposure therapy, 42 people: Some gains; mixed at 3 months. Claustrophobia 2014, 42 people: Helped or hurt, depending. Bipolar 2017, add-on, 37 people: Mood better; cognition not. Healthy adults 2016, one dose, 26 people: 7% more correct memory answers.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
